 Storage provider

 ▸ Cloudflare R2              account ID is on the R2 overview page
   Amazon S3                  use the regional endpoint for the bucket's region
   Backblaze B2               the S3-compatible endpoint, not the native B2 one
   MinIO or self-hosted       any S3-compatible endpoint you operate
   Other S3-compatible        enter the endpoint exactly as your provider documents it
